sec.title: Fake Conferences, OAuth and WhatsApp: Inside Russia’s New Espionage Tactics
sec.brief: S. S. S. S. CISA adds a Ray-Project Ray flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Google’s Threat Intelligence Group tracked three separate suspected Russia-linked cyber espionage clusters. All three focus on the same thing: abusing authentication features that are supposed to protect accounts to access them instead. Threat actors target researchers, academics, government officials, think-tank analysts, and defense sector personnel across Europe and the United States. The three clusters are tracked as UNC6293, UNC7005, and UNC5976 , and while they operate differently and with different tools, Google published them together for a reason.
